items.headline: Chaos takes over the Big Ten: UCLA, Indiana and Ohio State all lose in Week 12
items.description: UCLA, Indiana and Ohio State all lost to unranked teams in a year where parity is the ever-present theme.

items.headline: Nebraska's jab at Ohio State's 'THE' leads top Week 12 CFB trolls
items.description: Nebraska deployed a simple but effective troll that poked fun at its opponent's propensity to emphasize the "the" in "The Ohio State University."

items.headline: Preseason No. 1 Ohio State suffers fourth loss, will 'evaluate what's going on'
items.description: For coach Ryan Day and his Ohio State Buckeyes, the dream of a College Football Playoff run is dead, as the preseason No. 1 team in college football lost its fourth game on Saturday afternoon, a 31-28 decision at the hands of the Nebraska Cornhuskers.

items.headline: Who are the winningest college football coaches of all time?
items.description: From Saban to Paterno, there are many legendary college football coaches. Who has the best career record? Check out who has the most wins now.

items.headline: Ryan Day after Ohio State loss: 'There's a lot of things that have to change'

items.headline: Nebraska snaps AP Top 25 losing skid, upsets Ohio State
items.description: Nebraska broke its 31-game losing streak against AP Top 25 opponents with a 31-28 victory over No. 16 Ohio State on Saturday.
